inj.note: Though All will be eligible to return from IR as soon as Week 12, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network relays that the third-year tight end is feared to have sustained a season-ending ACL tear of his right knee during Sunday's 35-13 win over the Ravens. All will likely undergo further testing over the next day or two before the Bengals provide an updated diagnosis, but if the ACL tear is confirmed, the 26-year-old could be sidelined into the 2027 season. He previously tore the ACL in the same knee in 2023 during his final collegiate season at Iowa and during his 2024 rookie campaign with Cincinnati.

news.h: Bengals put TE Erick All Jr. on IR; believed to be torn ACL, per source
news.d: Bengals put TE Erick All Jr. on injured reserve Tuesday with an injury that's believed to be a torn ACL, a source told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.
